name: inner-animal
description: Free personality quiz that matches you to your inner animal from 130 species. Static SPA with an optional Express+SQLite backend for saved results and 6-digit email sign-in.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html animal_data.js animal_readings.js quiz_logic.js favicon.svg apple-touch-icon.png og-image.png robots.txt sitemap.xml llms.txt dist/ 2>/dev/null; cp -r images dist/; true
